freeze_timing_evidence.interpretation: Pinned driver orders setting selection, immutable confirmation-plan creation, then jobs; CLI rejects unselected confirmation settings. Command start journals and report mtimes agree. Current filesystem times are not an independent tamper-proof timestamp authority.

limits: Recorded final phase scalars, retained checkpoint names and restoration log messages checked; TensorBoard events/phase snapshots hashed, not independently parsed/deserialized.
Native-reported zero per-assay roundtrip errors and model-state hashes bound, not recomputed from weights.
State labels, transport costs, ridge state-transfer probes and neighborhood/hubness diagnostics not independently recomputed; no biological integration-validity or causal claim.

Integration seeds reuse identical biological cells and are not independent biological-world replicates. Successful fits do not establish the cause or repair of the earlier different-world baseline CUDA failure. The separate preserved retry is not an additional independent biological world.
scope: Only the two completed scGLUE align_high fits and fixed cached baseline references. JSON/public train-val-discovery NPZ reads, public H5AD/checkpoint/native-event byte hashes and source/version reads. Counts not decoded; no truth NPZ/private/protected cohort arrays or active new scMRDR outputs opened. No checkpoint/model deserialization, CUDA, fitting, causal evaluation or state/probe scoring rerun. Only outcome-free public ID sampling and arithmetic on embedded report aggregate scalars.

seed1_retry_provenance.interpretation: Fresh identical-seed/configuration/input retry, not a native checkpoint resume. This scientific artifact audit independently verifies the completed new fit; operational returncode0 alone was not accepted as model/export validation. Bitwise equality to the interrupted training trajectory is not claimed.
seed1_retry_provenance.process_visibility_limit: The append-only post-action audit preserves that both pre-action process checks were sandbox-scoped; host absence at archival is unproven. Later host checks found no old/orphan job. No process scan or operational action was repeated here.
